Spells:
Create Food And Water (Lesser Dragonmark Mark Of Hospitality3 Conj): R50' Creates enough food and water to sustain 30 humans or 10 horses for 24 hr; the food remains edible for 24 hr
Heroes' Feast (Greater Dragonmark Mark Of Hospitality6 Conj): R50' Creates food for 10 creatures that cures sickness and disease and gives 1d8+5 temporary hit points, +1 attacks and Will saves, and immunity to poison and fear for 12 hr
Leomund's Secure Shelter (Lesser Dragonmark Mark Of Hospitality4 Conj): R50' Creates a 20'x20' cottage, strong as a stone building, with secured entrances, resistance to fire, immunity to normal missiles, and an unseen servant that can perform tasks, for 20 hr
Mordenkainen's Magnificent Mansion (Greater Dragonmark Mark Of Hospitality7 Conj): R50' Allows self and designated creatures to enter an extradimensional dwelling with provisions for 120 for 20 hr
Prestidigitation (Least Dragonmark Mark Of Hospitality0 Univ): R10' Allows performing minor magic effects for 1 hr
Purify Food And Drink (Least Dragonmark Mark Of Hospitality0 Tran): R10' Makes 10 cubic feet of food and water safe to consume (save Will negates)
Unseen Servant (Least Dragonmark Mark Of Hospitality1 Conj): R50' Creates an invisible servant with Strength 2 and a 15' Speed that can perform simple tasks for 10 hr
Magic Notes:
Greater Dragonmark (Mark Of Hospitality): Can use a choice of Heroes' Feast or Mordenkainen's Magnificent Mansion once per day as a spell-like ability
Least Dragonmark (Mark Of Hospitality): Can use a choice of Purify Food And Drink 2 times per day, Prestidigitation 2 times per day, or Unseen Servant once per day as a spell-like ability
Lesser Dragonmark (Mark Of Hospitality): Can use a choice of Create Food And Water or Leomund's Secure Shelter once per day as a spell-like ability
